desc: Imp prince: black-violet body with a spiky red crystal mane, three layers of sharp small wings per side, a gold crown, long forked tail with gold tip, gold claws, toothy grin. Chibi 16-bit pixel art character sprite, big head, small body, right-facing 3/4, 1px navy outline, 2-3 flat shades, no gradients, no noise, no glow, no halo, no shadow. Black void face with small eyes. Palette lavender, white, violet, gold.
